query:
WITH poor_households AS (
  SELECT head_of_household_id 
  FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index 
  WHERE wealth_level = 'Poor'
),
living_saudi_poor AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN poor_households ph ON d.head_of_household_id = ph.head_of_household_id
  WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' 
    AND d.death_date IS NULL
    AND d.person_type = 'Saudi'
),
total_poor_population AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) as total_count
  FROM living_saudi_poor
),
higher_education_poor AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lsp.id) as higher_ed_count
  FROM living_saudi_poor lsp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala ug 
    ON lsp.id = ug.id
  WHERE ug.qualification IN ('ماجستير', 'دكتوراه')
)
SELECT 
  tp.total_count as total_poor_population,
  hp.higher_ed_count as higher_education_count,
  ROUND((hp.higher_ed_count * 100.0 / tp.total_count), 2) as percentage
FROM total_poor_population tp
CROSS JOIN higher_education_poor hp
LIMIT 100
